propositions: Container tickets with children fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation because they rarely declare file_impact, causing any unrelated commit to invalidate attestations and force re-review.

Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact to narrow invalidation scope, but only when all non-closed children have non-empty file_impact (poison rule).
The material_fingerprint lattice already pins direct children, so inheritance cannot silently drift one level deep; grandchild changes are covered by deeper tickets' own attestations.
Closed children should neither contribute files to the inherited union nor trigger poisoning, preserving the completion floor property that their work is not re-litigated.
The dependency_hashes function must receive children as an optional parameter threaded from the orchestrator's assembled context, avoiding new store reads and tickets-root ambiguity in attested mode.
P9 must surface an advisory when container inheritance is poisoned by undeclared children, naming them so authors understand why whole-HEAD fallback remains in effect.
